ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Neptune

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1796655995000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Mercury and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.
